            "text": "[profile.dev]",

          },
          {
            "text": "# Enable incremental compilation for faster rebuilds",
            "lineNumber": 301
          },
          {
            "text": "incremental = true",
            "lineNumber": 302
          },
          {
            "text": "# Use more codegen units for faster compilation (trade-off: less optimization)",

          },

          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 307
          },

            "text": "[profile.release]",
            "lineNumber": 308
          },
          {
            "text": "lto = \"fat\"",
            "lineNumber": 309
          },
          {
            "text": "# Because we bundle some of these executables with the TypeScript CLI, we",

          },
          {
            "text": "# remove everything to make the binary as small as possible.",
            "lineNumber": 311
          },
          {

          {
            "text": "# See https://github.com/openai/codex/issues/1411 for details.",

          },
          {
            "text": "codegen-units = 1",
            "lineNumber": 315
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 316
          },
          {
            "text": "[profile.ci-test]",

          },
          {
            "text": "debug = 1         # Reduce debug symbol size",

          },
          {
            "text": "inherits = \"test\"",

          },

          },

          },
          {

          },

        "relativeWorkspacePath": ".\\codex-rs\\tui\\src\\chatwidget.rs",

        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "//! The main Codex TUI chat surface.",
            "lineNumber": 1
          },
          {
            "text": "//!",
            "lineNumber": 2
          },
          {
            "text": "//! &#96;ChatWidget&#96; consumes protocol events, builds and updates history cells, and drives rendering",
            "lineNumber": 3
          },
          {
            "text": "//! for both the main viewport and overlay UIs.",
            "lineNumber": 4
          },
          {
            "text": "//!",
            "lineNumber": 5
          },
          {
            "text": "//! The UI has both committed transcript cells (finalized &#96;HistoryCell&#96;s) and an in-flight active",
            "lineNumber": 6
          },
          {
            "text": "//! cell (&#96;ChatWidget.active_cell&#96;) that can mutate in place while streaming (often representing a",
            "lineNumber": 7
          },
          {
            "text": "//! coalesced exec/tool group). The transcript overlay (&#96;Ctrl+T&#96;) renders committed cells plus a",
            "lineNumber": 8
          },
          {
            "text": "//! cached, render-only live tail derived from the current active cell so in-flight tool calls are",
            "lineNumber": 9
          },
          {
            "text": "//! visible immediately.",
            "lineNumber": 10
          },
          {
            "text": "//!",
            "lineNumber": 11
          },
          {
            "text": "//! The transcript overlay is kept in sync by &#96;App::overlay_forward_event&#96;, which syncs a live tail",
            "lineNumber": 12
          },
          {
            "text": "//! during draws using &#96;active_cell_transcript_key()&#96; and &#96;active_cell_transcript_lines()&#96;. The",
            "lineNumber": 13
          },
          {
            "text": "//! cache key is designed to change when the active cell mutates in place or when its transcript",
            "lineNumber": 14
          },
          {
            "text": "//! output is time-dependent so the overlay can refresh its cached tail without rebuilding it on",
            "lineNumber": 15
          },
          {
            "text": "//! every draw.",
            "lineNumber": 16
          },
          {
            "text": "//!",
            "lineNumber": 17
          },
          {
            "text": "//! The bottom pane exposes a single \"task running\" indicator that drives the spinner and interrupt",
            "lineNumber": 18
          },
          {
            "text": "//! hints. This module treats that indicator as derived UI-busy state: it is set while an agent turn",
            "lineNumber": 19
          },
          {
            "text": "//! is in progress and while MCP server startup is in progress. Those lifecycles are tracked",
            "lineNumber": 20
          },
          {
            "text": "//! independently (&#96;agent_turn_running&#96; and &#96;mcp_startup_status&#96;) and synchronized via",
            "lineNumber": 21
          },
          {
            "text": "//! &#96;update_task_running_state&#96;.",
            "lineNumber": 22
          },
          {
            "text": "use std::collections::HashMap;",
            "lineNumber": 23
          },
          {
            "text": "use std::collections::HashSet;",
            "lineNumber": 24
          },
          {
            "text": "use std::collections::VecDeque;",
            "lineNumber": 25
          },
          {
            "text": "use std::path::PathBuf;",
            "lineNumber": 26
          },

            "text": "use std::sync::Arc;",
            "lineNumber": 27
          },
          {
            "text": "use std::time::Duration;",
            "lineNumber": 28
          },

          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 30
          },
